title: Capstone: Multi-Client Chat Server
requirements: Use **Asio** (standalone, via vcpkg/FetchContent) — TCP server on a port; clients via `telnet`/`nc` or your own client
Version 1: thread-per-client with a mutex-protected room list
Version 2: Asio coroutines (`asio::awaitable`, `co_await async_read_until(...)`) on a small thread pool
Message history ring buffer per room; graceful shutdown with stop tokens
Load test: 500 simulated clients; measure messages/sec for both versions
